fixes.what: The 666 found event takes its land from western-gokturks, a state that ended nine years earlier and whose land went to the Tang.
fixes.why: western-gokturks.json ends in 657 (/ledger/24 dissolve, counterpart tang-dynasty; successors tang-dynasty and tokhara-yabghus, not turks). The Tang example (/ledger/11) gains Dzungaria and Semirechye from western-gokturks in 657. WTK page: the Tang 'destroyed the khaganate in 657-659'; 'Mishe was killed by Buzhen in 662 and Buzhen was killed in 666' (both were Tang proxy khagans).
fixes.fix: Set the found counterpart to tang-dynasty. Add tang-dynasty to /identity/predecessors with the Semirechye land. Keep western-gokturks only if its dossier is given turks as a successor.

fixes.what: The ledger draws an independent state for 666-698, but its main page calls the Western Turks a Tang vassal; no vassal_start or vassal_end is recorded.
fixes.why: WTK infobox: 'Vassal of the Tang dynasty (657-742)'. Text: 'Empress Wu Zetian sent Yuanqing and Boeri westward in 685 to succeed their fathers as proxy rulers'. The author's notes ask the Tang dossier for 'suzerainty over the Western Turks 659-679', but the mirror rule needs the vassal_start in this ledger too.
fixes.fix: Add vassal_start (counterpart tang-dynasty, region Semirechye, source WTK) at 666, and a vassal_end at Duzhi's revolt in 677. Add a second vassal_start at 685 for the proxy rulers Yuanqing and Boeri, ended at 690 or 698. Alternatively, say in notes why the infobox's vassal status does not apply.

fixes.what: The 698 dissolve gives Semirechye and Chach to turgesh, but the turgesh dossier takes only a 150 km Taraz core in 699 and gains Semirechye and Chach from tang-dynasty in 703. In 699-702 the land belongs to nobody, and the two sides disagree on who held it.
fixes.why: turgesh /ledger/0 (699 found, place Taraz 150 km, counterpart turks), /ledger/1 (703 gain from tang-dynasty of Semirechye, Dzungaria, Chach and Turpan), /keyframe_review/1 (699-702 Taraz only). WTK page: 'From 679 to 719 the old Goektuerk capital of Suyab was one of the Four Garrisons of Anxi'.
fixes.fix: Make both dossiers agree. Either the turks dissolve hands only the Taraz core to turgesh and adds a loss of the rest of Semirechye and Chach to tang-dynasty, or turgesh /ledger/0 takes the whole Semirechye in 699 and its 703 gain names turks or nobody for that part.

fixes.what: Suyab is the capital for 666-698, although the page this capital cites makes Suyab a Tang garrison from 679. The capital's own note admits that the page does not say where the post-657 Turks sat.
fixes.why: WTK page: 'From 679 to 719 the old Goektuerk capital of Suyab was one of the Four Garrisons of Anxi.'
fixes.fix: End the Suyab capital at 678. For 679-698, give no capital, or name Navekat (summer seat) with a note.

fixes.what: The 674 gain of Dzungaria (750 cells) names counterpart nobody, but the Tang held that land from 657 in the Tang example.
fixes.why: _example-tang-dynasty.json /ledger/11: '657 gain western-gokturks, Dzungaria + Semirechye'. The event is confidence 1 (Cliopatria's year).
fixes.fix: Change the counterpart to tang-dynasty (the Duolu tribes under the Tang Mengchi/Kunling protectorates), or say in the note why the land was no one's.

fixes.fix: Use the Western Turkic Khaganate's own Wikidata item, or leave the item out and say so in notes.

fixes.what: The 703-735 corrections draw Beshbalik (200 km) and Turpan (150 km) as Turgesh land, but the same page has the Turgesh attacking Tang Ting Prefecture in 735. The 736 'loss of Beshbalik' therefore loses land the page gives to the Tang.
fixes.why: Tuergesh page: 'In 735 the Turgesh attacked Ting Prefecture (Jimsar County).' The Tang example holds Gaochang/Xi Prefecture (Turfan) from 640 and has no 703 loss. The 703 sentence 'from Chach to Turfan and Beshbaliq' can be read as reaching those towns rather than holding them.
fixes.fix: Either take place:Beshbalik and place:Turpan out of the 703-735 corrections and drop or re-type /ledger/9, or explain in the keyframe notes why Ting and Xi prefectures are drawn as Turgesh. Settle this with ea-04's tang-dynasty dossier.
